name: Titan Company Ltd.
business_summary: Tata Group lifestyle company: jewellery (Tanishq, Mia, Zoya, CaratLane; ~85% of revenue, India's largest organised jeweller), watches & wearables (Titan, Fastrack, Sonata), eyecare, fragrances, Taneira and international (Damas in the Gulf, consolidated from Jan 2026). Network 3,758 stores (78 net adds in Q2 FY27). TTM revenue Rs92,417cr, EBITDA margin ~10%. Gold is bought largely through gold-metal loans/lease (interest Rs1.26k cr TTM), so unit margin is hedged but volumes and working capital track gold prices. P/E 73x, ROE 38%.

revenue_mix.segment: Eyecare, emerging (fragrance, Taneira, Indian dress wear)

exposures.mechanism: Jewellery ~85% of revenue (Tanishq, Mia, Zoya, CaratLane). +10% volume demand => revenue +8.5% at ~12% contribution margin vs 10% EBITDA margin => EBITDA +10-11% x EV/MCap 1.05 x persistence 0.5 => ~+5.5, shaded to +5. Q2 FY27 jewellery +21% (domestic) vs consensus ~19.3% (CLSA) but below JPMorgan 25% and stock fell 4-5% on 7 Oct.

evidence.note: Q2 FY27 update: consumer businesses +25%, jewellery ~+21% (studded low-30s%, plain ~20%), watches ~+30%, eyecare ~+28%, 78 net stores to 3,758; international +97% incl. Damas; some festive demand moved to Q3

exposures.mechanism: Gold on lease/hedged so unit margin is stable; higher gold lifts ticket value and revenue (+) and inventory-gain optics, but a sharp spike cuts volumes (elasticity ~-0.4 on weight) and shifts mix to lighter jewellery (studded). Net sign ambiguous: +8% gold => revenue +5%, volume -3% => EBITDA ~+1% to +3%; gold is -8.4% since June and +3.4% 12m. Pack empirical +0.79 (t=1.3).

exposures.mechanism: +5pp duty raises domestic gold ~4.7%: demand/volume down, grey-market smuggling up; organised players hedge via GML so margin is largely neutral, with short-term inventory gain partially offsetting. Net ~-1.5 (range includes +1 for organised share gain).

evidence.note: July 2024 duty cut to 6%; current duty level not re-verified

exposures.mechanism: Hallmarking (HUID), PAN/KYC and GST enforcement shift share from ~60% unorganised jewellery to organised; Titan has ~6% share. +1 => organised share gain 2pp => revenue +3% => EBITDA +4% x persistence 1.0 (structural) => ~+3.
Watches, eyecare, fragrances and metro jewellery are urban discretionary; +5pp => revenue +3% => EBITDA +5% x 0.5 => +2.5. Watches ~+30% and eyecare ~+28% in Q2 FY27.

exposures.mechanism: Studded jewellery growing low-30s% vs plain ~20% lifts gross margin (studded ~1.5-2x plain margin); +1 => studded mix +3pp => margin +0.3pp => EBITDA +3% x persistence 0.7 => +2.
